For this state/province it documents the facility bans signed in March 2025.

An independent travel-safety outlet's July 2026 anti-trans legal-risk assessment map (republished 27 Aug 2026 by a regional LGBTQ news site; built from 5 years of daily legislative tracking): per state/province grading of anti-trans legal risk. The map includes an entry for this state/province. It records four states/provinces whose bathroom restrictions reach felony-level penalties (the newest ban carries up to 5 years and was partially court-blocked but remains in force wherever no gender-neutral option exists), one state/province's bounty-hunter civil-suit regime, and a national frame holding that severe policies are in effect.
